title: Maturity & Reset Calendar
intro: Every balloon (maturity), ARM rate reset and interest-only step-up in the book — as a list or month by month — with the loans that need a maturity decision on top. Click any event to open its loan.

topics.title: Open the calendar
topics.intro: The calendar opens in its own tab, from the “+” at the end of the tab strip.

steps.title: The “+” menu
steps.text: Click the “+” at the end of the tab strip, then “Maturity & Reset Calendar”.

marks.text: Opens this menu: a tool in a tab of its own.

marks.label: Maturity & Reset Calendar
marks.text: Opens the calendar (this chapter). If it is already open, it takes you to its tab.

steps.title: The Calendar tab
steps.text: The calendar is built from every active loan in the book (an archived property, a removed or paid-off loan is left out) and is redrawn whenever a loan changes. Your view and filters stay as you left them while the tab is open.

marks.label: Portfolio
marks.text: Back to the portfolio. The calendar tab stays open.

marks.label: Calendar
marks.text: This tab.

marks.label: Pop out
marks.text: Opens the calendar in a window of its own — handy on a second screen. Clicking an event there still opens the loan here.

marks.label: Close tab
marks.text: Closes the calendar. Nothing is lost — it is rebuilt from the loans next time.

marks.label: Maturity & Reset Calendar
marks.text: The title, and the day it was built (today).

marks.label: The tool bar
marks.text: List or Calendar, the filters, Sort, Clear and Print (the “Narrow it down” topic).

marks.label: Needs a maturity decision
marks.text: Loans that have matured or whose extension is undecided — always on top.

marks.label: The four tiles
marks.text: The totals at a glance; each tile is also a filter.

marks.label: Maturity wall
marks.text: How much debt comes due each year.

topics.title: What’s coming up
topics.intro: The List view, from the top: the decisions, the four tiles, the maturity wall and every event in date order.

steps.title: Needs a maturity decision
steps.text: A red box on top lists every loan that needs a decision about its maturity: a loan whose status is “Matured” (set by hand, or by itself once the maturity date has passed) or “Extension undecided” (set by hand in the loan’s edit form, Loan Status). It stays here — even after the date has passed — until you change the status (Extended, Paid off…).

marks.label: Needs a maturity decision (2)
marks.text: How many loans wait for a decision.

marks.label: Extension undecided
marks.text: The loan’s status: an extension is being discussed and not yet settled.

marks.label: Matured
marks.text: The loan has reached its maturity (or you marked it so) and is not extended or paid off yet.

marks.label: The loan
marks.text: Click the row to open that loan’s page.

marks.label: Date · balloon
marks.text: Its maturity date and the balloon (what is left to pay then).

steps.title: The four tiles
steps.text: Four totals over the loans the filters let through. Click a tile and the list below shows exactly the loans it counts; click it again to show everything.

marks.label: Debt maturing (shown)
marks.text: The balloons of every maturity in the calendar added up, and how many there are.

marks.label: Maturing (next 12 mo)
marks.text: Loans whose maturity falls within the next 12 months.

marks.label: ARM resets (next 12 mo)
marks.text: Adjustable-rate loans whose rate (and payment) changes within 12 months.

marks.label: IO step-ups (next 12 mo)
marks.text: Loans whose interest-only period ends within 12 months — the payment steps up to principal and interest.

steps.title: Maturity wall
steps.text: Debt coming due by year: one bar per year, as long as that year’s balloons. This year’s and next year’s bars are red.

marks.label: The year
marks.text: Each year with at least one maturity.

marks.label: A red bar
marks.text: Coming due this year or next — the closest refinancings.

marks.label: A green bar
marks.text: A later year. The longest bar is the year with the most debt maturing.

marks.label: The amount
marks.text: The total of that year’s balloons.

steps.title: Upcoming events
steps.text: Every event in date order, grouped by year. A row within the next 12 months has a yellow background; a loan needing a maturity decision has a pink one. Click any row to open that loan.

marks.label: Date
marks.text: The day of the event: the maturity date, the payment date the new rate starts, or the first full payment after interest-only.

marks.label: Event
marks.text: Maturity (red), ARM reset (amber) or IO ends (green).

marks.label: Loan
marks.text: The loan.

marks.label: Amount
marks.text: The balloon for a maturity; the balance at that date for a reset or an IO step-up.

marks.label: Detail
marks.text: In words: the balloon due, the new rate and payment, or the new P&I payment.

marks.label: Year
marks.text: Where each year’s events start.

marks.label: Within 12 months
marks.text: A yellow row is less than a year away.

marks.label: The kind of event
marks.text: Maturity, ARM reset or IO ends.

marks.label: Needs a decision
marks.text: A pink row: the loan matured or its extension is undecided — its status is shown next to the event.

topics.title: Month by month
topics.intro: The Calendar view: one box per year; open a year to see its twelve months.

steps.title: The Calendar view
steps.text: Click “Calendar” in the tool bar. The first year with events is open; the others are closed. Each event is a small card in its month, edged in its colour.

marks.label: List
marks.text: Back to the list view.

marks.label: Calendar
marks.text: This view.

marks.label: The colours
marks.text: Red = maturity, amber = ARM reset, green = interest-only ends.

marks.label: A year
marks.text: The year, how many events and how much matures. Click it to close or open its months.

marks.label: A month
marks.text: The month’s events. An empty month says “—”.

marks.label: An event
marks.text: The loan, the kind of event and the amount. Point at it to read the detail; click it to open the loan.

steps.title: Open another year
steps.text: Click a closed year’s line to open its twelve months; click an open one to close it. Several years can be open at once.

marks.label: A closed year
marks.text: ▸ = closed. Click to open it.

marks.label: An open year
marks.text: ▾ = open: its twelve months are below.

marks.label: Needs a decision
marks.text: A loan that matured or whose extension is undecided is marked in red (or amber) with a warning line.

marks.label: An event
marks.text: Click it to open the loan.

topics.title: Narrow it down
topics.intro: The tool bar’s filters work in both views and on the four tiles. They stay while the tab is open; Clear removes them all.

steps.title: Lender
steps.text: Click “Lender” for the list of every lender in the book. Tick one or more: only their loans are shown, and the button says how many are ticked.

marks.label: Lender
marks.text: Opens and closes this list.

marks.label: Every lender
marks.text: Tick a lender to show only its loans; tick several to show all of theirs.

marks.label: A tick box
marks.text: On = this lender’s loans are shown.

steps.title: A lender ticked
steps.text: With one lender ticked, the tiles, the wall and the list count only that lender’s loans. Untick it (or click Clear) to see everything again.

marks.label: Lender (1)
marks.text: One lender is ticked.

marks.label: The tiles
marks.text: Now only that lender’s loans.

marks.label: The wall
marks.text: Only that lender’s maturities.

steps.title: Loans
steps.text: Click “Loans” to pick loans by name. Type in the search box to shorten the list, then tick the loans to show.

marks.label: Loans
marks.text: Opens and closes this list.

marks.label: Search loans
marks.text: Type part of a name; only the loans that match stay in the list.

marks.label: The loans
marks.text: Tick a loan to show only it; tick several to show them together.

steps.title: Amount and Sort
steps.text: Amount keeps only events between a smallest and a largest amount — type 5m for 5 million or 750k for 750 thousand; leave a box blank for no limit. Sort orders the list by date (grouped by year), or by amount, smallest or largest first.

marks.label: Amount — min
marks.text: Smallest amount shown (here 50m = $50,000,000).

marks.label: Amount — max
marks.text: Largest amount shown. Blank = no limit.

marks.label: Sort
marks.text: Date, Smallest amount or Largest amount.

marks.label: Counted again
marks.text: The tiles, the wall and the list count only the events of $50,000,000 or more. Further down, the list is now largest first and not grouped by year.

steps.title: The Sort choices
steps.text: The three ways to order the list.

marks.label: Date
marks.text: By date, earliest first, grouped by year (the usual order).

marks.label: Smallest amount
marks.text: Smallest amount first.

marks.label: Largest amount
marks.text: Largest amount first.

steps.title: Clear and Print
steps.text: Clear removes every filter (lenders, loans, amounts, search and the tile you clicked); the view and the sort stay. Print opens your computer’s print window with the calendar as you see it now — the tool bar is left off the paper.

marks.label: Clear
marks.text: Removes every filter.

marks.label: Print
marks.text: Prints the calendar (or saves it as a PDF from the print window).

marks.label: Back to blank
marks.text: No filter is on after Clear.

marks.label: Sort stays
marks.text: Clear doesn’t change the order — set Sort back to Date yourself.

steps.title: A tile as a filter
steps.text: Click a tile — here “Maturing (next 12 mo)”. The list switches to just the loans that tile counts, and a line under the tiles says what is shown. Click the tile again, or that line, to show everything.

marks.label: The tile you clicked
marks.text: Outlined while it filters the list.

marks.label: Showing …
marks.text: What the list shows now. Click here to show everything again.

marks.label: Only those loans
marks.text: The rows are exactly the ones the tile counts.

topics.title: Open a loan from an event
topics.intro: Every event — a row in the list, a card in a month, a line in the decision box — opens its loan.

marks.label: An event
marks.text: Click it: the app goes to Portfolio, opens this loan and jumps to that payment in its schedule.

steps.title: The loan, at that payment
steps.text: The app switches to Portfolio, opens the loan and scrolls its amortization schedule to the payment of the event, lit up for a few seconds. The Calendar tab stays open in the tab strip at the top — click it to go back.

marks.label: Amortization Schedule
marks.text: The loan’s payment schedule, on the loan’s page under Portfolio.

marks.label: The payment
marks.text: The schedule row of the event’s date (“pays MM/DD/YYYY”), lit up for a few seconds — here the final payment, the balloon.
